In summary, the asymmetric, protecting-group-free synthesis
of janthinoid A (1) is accomplished for the first time in 14
steps starting from the commercially available geranylacetone.
The enabling tandem reactions of Lewis-acid-mediated
cationic-allene-ene cyclization and
\mathrm { F e ( C l O _ { 4 } ) _ { 3 } }
-mediated oxida-
tive annulation provide novel ways for the synthesis of the
trans-decalin-based aldehyde 11 and the oxabicyclo[3.2.1]-
octane core 19 in a regio- and stereoselective manner.
Application of the developed chemistry for the synthesis of
other types of complex natural products is currently underway
in our laboratories and will be reported in due course.
